items.title: FDA cites record request breakdowns in trio of warning letters to API makers
items.summary: In a series of regulatory wrist-slaps now made public, the FDA has taken three manufacturers to task over record request breakdowns.

items.title: Legend Biotech shares fall 16% after first earnings report under new CEO
items.summary: Legend Biotech’s shares tumbled 16% Tuesday following the CAR-T company’s third-quarter earnings report, marking a rocky debut for newly installed CEO Ingrid Zhang.

items.title: Aurobindo unit Eugia recalls antibiotic lot, citing glass particle concerns
items.summary: Eugia, a unit of Aurobindo, issued a voluntary recall for one lot of the antibiotic vancomycin hydrochloride for injection, citing the possible presence of glass particles in the vials.

items.title: Lilly’s Foundayo marketing push keeps pace with another celeb partner in comedian Leanne Morgan
items.summary: The new celebrity partnership is the second for Lilly's oral GLP-1 Foundayo following its recent partnership with lifestyle guru Martha Stewart.

items.title: Merck KGaA lands FDA nod in rare tumor disorder, portending Ono, Daiichi showdown
items.summary: The FDA’s decision was based on Merck’s phase 3 Maneuver trial and follows similar approvals by other global regulators, including in China, Canada and Switzerland.

items.title: ImmunityBio juggles phase 3 win and 20% stock crash en route to Anktiva front-line expansion
items.summary: ImmunityBio's Anktiva secured a pivotal phase 3 win in front-line non-muscle invasive bladder cancer, but lack of detailed data and disappointing third-quarter financials sent the biotech's stock tumbling by 20%.

items.title: Summit sheds commercial leaders ahead of ivonescimab's FDA decision
items.summary: Summit Therapeutics is gearing up for ivonescimab’s high-stakes FDA decision without its chief commercial officer following a quiet shake-up of its launch division.

items.title: J&J readies Caplyta for FDA label expansion after 2nd phase 3 win in bipolar mania
items.summary: J&J is gearing up to expand the commercial reach of Caplyta after scoring a second phase 3 victory in bipolar mania.

items.title: After court win, WuXi AppTec scores removal from US list of Chinese military companies
items.summary: Following a back-and-forth with the Pentagon this year, contracting juggernaut WuXi AppTec appears to have largely evaded its designation by the U.S. as a company with ties to the Chinese military.

items.title: FDA orders new eye risk be listed on a dozen GLP-1s, including Novo's Ozempic, Lilly's Zepbound
items.summary: After an internal investigation, the FDA is calling for 12 GLP-1s to add a new and rare eye risk to the "warnings and precautions" section of their labels.

items.title: Phillips Medisize strikes deal to expand UK inhalation production
items.summary: Phillips Medisize, a Molex subsidiary CDMO that focuses on inhalation products and other medical and diagnostic products, is growing its manufacturing footprint in the U.K.

items.title: AchieveRx stubs out old identity ahead of smoking cessation launch
items.summary: Achieve Life Sciences has rebranded to align its name and stock ticker with its focus on helping people quit smoking and vaping.

items.title: Insulet, Marvel Comics smash diabetes stigma with new Omnipod-powered superhero
items.summary: Insulet's newest Marvel Comics collab looks to empower people with diabetes by representing the community through a new diabetes superhero, Gluconaut in "Gluconaut: Strength of Stars."

items.title: UCB continues reign as largest drug ad spender as Bimzelx once again tops the ranks
items.summary: UCB’s immunology drug Bimzelx has topped the pharma drug ad spending charts for the third month in a row.

items.title: Vertex lays off 78 Crinetics staffers amid $10B integration
items.summary: Vertex has decided to lay off 78 employees at Crinetics Pharmaceuticals following its $10 billion acquisition of the endocrine disease drug developer.

items.title: Bayer brings factor XIa to US stroke prevention with FDA nod for 1st-in-class asundexian
items.summary: Shortly after locking down a world-first approval in China, Bayer is bringing its groundbreaking stroke prevention drug stateside, with an FDA green light that honors the German drugmaker’s cardiovascular heritage and signals the sort of first-in-class opportunities it’s increasingly seeking in parallel.

items.title: Veradermics wraps phase 3 program in men with 'better-than-expected' hair growth at 1 year
items.summary: In a new readout of 12-month data, Veradermics' oral minoxidil delivered the best hair growth data of its phase 3 program so far alongside solid one-year safety data.

items.title: FDA opens safety probe into Novartis’ Zolgensma over potential tumor risks
items.summary: In its Nov. 6 communique about its Zolgensma safety probe, the FDA also flagged two recent reports of other gene therapy candidates where AAV vector integration drove tumor formation.

items.title: J&J’s Icotyde pill drives biologic-like efficacy in psoriatic arthritis despite high-dose miss
items.summary: Icotyde's strong phase 3 data in biologic-naïve patients with psoriatic arthritis were stained by one disappointment as a high dose missed statistical significance on the primary endpoint.

items.title: Lilly looks to gird Foundayo label after late-stage win in sleep apnea
items.summary: Lilly's oral GLP-1 Foundayo significantly reduced sleep apnea severity in a phase 3 study presented at the AHA Scientific Sessions on Monday. Now, the pharma is approaching the FDA in hopes of a label expansion.
